title: Refinement list limit improvement
body:
The default limit should be 1000 to fit the API's default configuration.
Remove the limit option from the component itself, it's enough to have it in the
widget.
Set the maxValuesPerFacet if not set to optimize the JSON answer
payload.

Fix #155

comments.body: Please be careful about PRS, we need to have rebased commits once ready so that we can continue easily releasing instantsearch and generate changelogs. Contributing.md has all the info
Not sure I get it; I should have squashed the commits together?
Yes if they belong to the same fix or feature (ie if having them separate is noise for the users and changelog then you do not jeed multiple commits)
Got it, so nothing to do with the rebase here, right?
I dont know, I always use git rebase -i to merge commits. No matter the tool the goal is to avoid commit noise
